summary: Frontend-only UX overhaul testing for new Homepage, Resources page, Header nav, and Footer. All 51 UI assertions passed (100%). Verified all new homepage sections (hero, trust strip, choose path, board selection, why edvnova, subjects, testimonials, final CTA), Resources page (search, category filters, type/access dropdowns, clear filters, empty state, browse-topics CTA), Header (6 nav links, no Profile Building in main nav), and existing routes (/boards, /igcse, /igcse/chemistry/atomic-structure/isotopes, /programs, /login, /about, /workshops, /contact, /admin, /dashboard). Admin login still works with admin@edvnova.com / Admin@123. Backend not retested (per request - frontend-only). Console shows expected 401 from /api/auth/me when unauthenticated (not a bug).

critical_code_review_comments: Home.js (357 lines) and Resources.js (315 lines) are well-organized and within healthy size limits.
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes (excellent test coverage support).
Resources.js uses useMemo correctly for derived state (subjects, types, filteredResources, subjectCounts) preventing unnecessary recomputes.

Resources fetch uses withCredentials: true correctly. /api/resources is loaded once on mount; empty error state isn't shown to user — minor: consider showing an error UI if axios throws (currently only console.error).
Header has 6 nav links as required; Profile Building correctly moved out of main nav (still accessible via Footer Company section).
